materialFindings: Exact services are arbitration-mediation, banking-finance and healthcare-medical-liability.
Federal arbitration procedural deadlines do not automatically apply to DIFC/ADGM; institutional emergency eligibility distinct from tribunal power.
DIAC2022 official AppendixII verifies pre-constitution application and tightly conditional without-notice request.
CBUAE consumer reimbursement has fraud/gross-negligence exception; restructuring rejection requires written reasons, not automatic acceptance.
Medical Liability Article18 requires committee presentation before compensation action acceptance.
DHA2026 access right and DOHSeptember2026 complaint/appeal processes are local regulator-specific.
Personal guarantee main-remedy gap remains; no invented newlaw guarantee rule or universal financial-free-zone consumer remedy.
